So, I've dipped my toes in the world of Phenibut a while back here there, always enjoying the anxiolytic benefits, but this past week I decided to finally pull the trigger and get a supply of my own. I went with Liftmode for my supply because I've had great results with their L-Theanine (may do a review on that eventually) and also because their package design and shipping times are great. I'm also a sucker for free shipping. I definitely wanted capsules, domestic shipment (USA), and since I believe their L Theanine was among the cheapest for a personal use amount capsules when I shopped around, I kind of instinctually went with them.

I received the order this week, and I am quite satisfied with the quality of the Phenibut. Compared to the brands at Health Food stores, the Liftmode Phenibut inside the capsules looks considerably more white. The lab report was included in print (a nice assurance) and was easy to read. V cool.

So, onto the experience itself. I took one 300mg capsule when the package arrived and settled into bed after a long day of studying. The effects were subtle, but perceptible. I noticed my verbal fluency was increased as I talked to my friends, and I think that may be due to its anxiety quelling properties. The calmness from this dose reminded me of the pleasurable "buzz" that comes after sitting in meditation for a while. Though I've personally fallen out of that discipline, it made me want to start again and reclaim that for my own mind. Though I was cautious about phenibut after reading reports of withdrawal (which does occur from serious abuse, so please don't do it to yourself), I can see how has the potential to reinforce good habits in stressful situations if used properly.

I took another dose today before a presentation, and though I didn't feel particularly buzzed or inhibited in any way, I immediately got compliments from my peers on the quality of my presentation. Though I could feel my heart rate increase as I went to speak (and knew this was probably from the caffeine I'd taken to put the presentation together earlier in the day), I didn't stumble or waiver in my voice and found myself completing off-the-cuff thoughts with a bit more ease than I probably would have otherwise.

My complaints with the experience may be due to the nature of the substance itself, but the potential for an uncomfortable withdrawal is concerning. It is the kind of supplement I wish I could take everyday, but my research tells me that this is unwise. I think the dosage instructions on the label are smart: up to 900mg dosed twice a day at two times a week max, and no more that 12 capsules (3.6 grams) per week total. This is a substance that has the potential for abuse, so I appreciate the sternness on these guidelines.

Overall I'm satisfied, glad I ordered. This is the product listing I used, but please don't take this as an endorsement since I am, honestly, very new to the world of phenibut. I encourage everyone to shop around and find the best product for their needs and budget. Again, please be cautious of experimenting with any kind of phenibut. Just passing my experience along, hope its maybe helpful to others who were curious but maybe hesitant about a sober look at the chemical.
